plain: Having a lawsuit ended because the person suing did not go on with it.

webster.text: Adjudged to have deserted the suit by default of appearance; as a plaintiff.

example.quote: The plantife in all Actions brought in any Court shall have libertie to withdraw his Action, or to be nonsuited before the Jurie hath given in their verdict, in which case he shall alwaies pay full cost and chardges to the defendant, and may afterwards renew his suite at an other Court if he please.
